findings.description: Two E-prime violations in one sentence: 'isn't' (is + not) and 'it's' (it + is). Post underwent E-prime remediation but this sentence retained contractions of 'to be'.
findings.suggestion: Rewrite: 'This does not constitute opposition — it reflects the absence of a position.'
findings.context: This isn't opposition — it's the absence of a position.

findings.description: E-prime violation: 'isn't' in body prose. Also appears in section heading 'Why This Isn't Code Review' (line 91).
findings.suggestion: Line 55: 'What CSP blocks does not involve the script load' or restructure. Line 91: 'Why This Does Not Constitute Code Review'.
findings.context: What CSP blocks isn't the script load; it blocks the `connect-src` outbound report.

findings.description: E-prime violation: 'to be denied healthcare' uses infinitive of 'to be'. Also line 71: 'the AI is ours' (0.88 confidence).
findings.suggestion: Line 75: 'Claude cannot feel what denial of healthcare means.' Line 71: 'the AI belongs to us' or 'we built the AI'.
findings.context: Claude cannot feel what it means to be denied healthcare.

findings.description: 'The OBBBA cut $990B in every version' presents a specific dollar figure without citation, source, or methodology reference. Readers encountering this observation panel will treat it as authoritative.
findings.suggestion: Add parenthetical source: '(KFF analysis, 2025)' or link to the evidence page where the figure receives full sourcing.
findings.context: The OBBBA cut $990B in every version.

findings.description: Post uses 'Jevons Paradox' and 'Jevons Explosion' but the project glossary standardizes on 'Jevons Effect'. Inconsistent with project vocabulary.
findings.suggestion: Use 'Jevons Effect' as the canonical term, matching glossary entry ID 'jevons-effect'. 'Jevons Explosion' may appear as H3's name but the underlying concept should reference the glossary term.
findings.context: H3 (Jevons Explosion): When efficiency improvements reduce the effective cost...

findings.description: Section heading 'What This Isn't' contains contraction of 'is not'. Headings carry high visibility and set reading expectations.
findings.suggestion: Rewrite heading: 'What This Does Not Cover' or 'Scope Boundaries'.

findings.description: E-prime violation: 'ambiguity is deliberate' uses bare 'is' copula.
findings.suggestion: Rewrite: 'senators maintain strategic ambiguity deliberately' or 'strategic ambiguity serves a deliberate purpose'.
findings.context: In other cases, strategic ambiguity is deliberate.

findings.description: Universal negative claim without citation: 'No prior policy analysis on record has had this structural property.' Requires either exhaustive survey evidence or an epistemic hedge.
findings.suggestion: Add hedge: 'No prior policy analysis we identified shares this structural property' or cite a literature search.
findings.context: No prior policy analysis on record has had this structural property — the instrument and the subject belong to the same class of entity.

findings.description: Politician lens framing claims 'maintaining safety guarantees' but the post body acknowledges cognitive load 'remains the binding constraint' and the architecture received evaluation 'primarily from the system that built it'. The framing overstates demonstrated properties.
findings.suggestion: Soften to 'while preserving critical safety checks' or add a qualifier about self-evaluation limitations.
findings.context: reduces AI system overhead by 31-72% while maintaining safety guarantees

findings.description: 'OBBBA' appears without expansion or glossary link. A voter-lens reader encountering this observation panel would lack context for the acronym.
findings.suggestion: Expand on first use: 'the One Big Beautiful Bill Act (OBBBA)' or link to the glossary entry.
findings.context: The OBBBA cut $990B in every version.

payload.scan_notes: All 5 commits in range focused on E-prime remediation. Scan found residual E-prime violations concentrated in contractions (isn't, it's) and infinitives (to be). Fair witness findings cluster around unqualified statistics and overclaims in lens framings. 9 of 20 files passed all 4 dimensions cleanly.

epistemic_flags: E-prime detection relies on pattern matching — idiomatic uses of 'be' in quotations or technical contexts may produce false positives
Fair witness findings on lens framings assess the framing against the post body — the framing may deliberately simplify for persona accessibility
Vocabulary consistency checks reference the glossary at scan time (49 terms) — terms added after this scan would change findings
